name: Rallying Standard
notes: Source implementation; runtime/co-op validation pending. Old perk ID retained. Uses source Warrior's Killing Spree, Brutality and Killer Physique; allies maintain the native stack pool with kills. Requires learned Killing Spree.
summary: Standard pulses grant your improved Killing Spree to you and allies, up to 10 stacks, without overlapping grants. Allies maintain stacks with their own kills.
